description: Several small bowls in different shades of blue sit on a dark cloth in front of a draped pillow. The left hand reaches forward to the small stack of light teal bowls, slides and lifts it toward the center, then lifts the darker teal bowl and places it onto the stack; next the left hand lifts the light purple bowl and sets it on top, forming one taller stack while the right hand stays nearby without touching any bowl.
